description: This file defines an interface and a class related to durable, versioned storage of a generic value in the Orleans framework. The DurableValue class implements state machine logic, including applying log entries, persisting state, and version management.

classes.name: DurableValue<T>
classes.description: A sealed class implementing durable, versioned storage of a value with serialization, logging, and state machine management logic.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Getter and setter for the stored value, marking it as dirty on set.

methods.name: OnModified
methods.description: Marks the state as dirty, indicating it needs to be persisted.

methods.name: OnValuePersisted
methods.description: Invokes the OnPersisted callback if set.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a log entry to update the current value based on versioned command data.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Appends the current state to the log if dirty.

methods.name: AppendSnapshot
methods.description: Writes a snapshot of the current state.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Not implemented; would create a deep copy of the object.

methods.name: WriteState
methods.description: Serializes the current value into the storage writer.
